pilot.independentInterpretation: All 27 original source-to-target paths and source context independently reviewed. All 3271 retained WCVP raw-line hashes and 316 inventory witness hashes independently checked.

admittedScope.qualification: Only the admitted immutable inventory witnesses and pinned WCVP v16 reference under the current catalog. MAIN individually reviewed all 172 mapped candidate contexts and retained seven explicit holds; the full adapter tests passed for all 165 eligible witnesses, including one already-known pair.

rules: Preserve original full specimen names and dates, including missing dates.
Accepted catalog concept must contain the source accepted concept; a shared broader species parent alone does not resolve sibling concepts.
Preserve all original geography, date, identity and cultivation checks and seven reviewed context holds.
Retain Kew CC BY 3.0 reference attribution and NYBG CC0 source attribution.
Emit historical occurrence only; no current persistence, establishment, absence or non-detection follows.
Revalidate on changes to source row, inventory, catalog, reference, resolver or interpretation; no generic fuzzy matching or arbitrary-name acceptance.
